column1: # Prompt shape identical to bench-local.sh / p14s-setup/toolbox-raw/bench-host.sh
# (1500x code line + random nonce => ~18k tokens, cold prefill, max_tokens=300, temp 0.7).
# HOST IS NOT p14. ThinkPad P16s Gen 4 AMD (21RX000JUS), same SoC as p14
# (Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370 / Radeon 890M, gfx1150), same BIOS R2XET39W 1.19,
# same GTT 49152 MiB, same llama.cpp build 458 (b10333-b746971b5), same bundled
# Mesa 26.3.0 via the toolbox wrapper, same model and same sec9c flags.
# Differs in chassis (16" vs 14") and RAM: 96 GB as 2x48 GB DDR5-5600 SODIMM,
# vs p14's 60 GB. Hostname is still "p14" -- the install was moved, not rebuilt.
# Protocol: 2x2 of GPU DPM x CPU governor, 5 fully interleaved rounds (all four
# arms visited every round, 20 runs total), single server process throughout.
# All rows probe=1: sysfs telemetry (sclk/busy/power/temp) was sampled at 1 Hz
# during every run, so the probe cost is common to all arms.
# sclk/busy/watts/tempC are MEDIANS over samples where gpu_busy_percent > 50.
# Round 1 is a cold-chassis outlier in the dpm-auto arms only (476.6 falling to
# ~430 by round 2 and staying there). This is the same "discard the first rep"
# effect the p14 README documents, but the mechanism here is chassis heat soak,
# not GPU clock ramp -- the dpm-high arms show no round-1 effect at all.
#   arm                        PP    sd     TG    sclk    W    degC
#   DPM high vs auto        +12.6%  (483.6 vs 435.6 pooled over governor)
#   gov performance vs pwr   +0.1%  (459.2 vs 458.7 pooled over DPM) -- nothing
#   interaction: performance helps at auto (+1.7%), hurts at high (-1.3%)
# p14 comparison, same prompt, same software, both at steady state:
# The P16s' UNTUNED state (436) is within 10% of the p14's FULLY TUNED state (483).
# The p14's presenting problem -- prefill at half the documented rate on a cold
# "auto" GPU -- does not occur on this chassis.
